components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default call-to-action, tactile and friendly with an offset crayon shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.875rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; background: var(--color-yellow); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-hand); font-size: 1.1875rem; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--color-ink); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--color-ink); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(174, 228, 214, 0.45); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--color-ink); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action button for back links and lower-pressure calls to action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 2px dashed var(--color-ink); border-radius: 0.875rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-hand); font-size: 1.1875rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: rgba(253, 233, 138, 0.4); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(174, 228, 214, 0.45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 1.05rem; padding: 0.75rem; background: #ffffff; color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: 0 0.5rem 1.2rem rgba(46, 61, 58, 0.08); } .ds-nav__brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-width: 0; margin-right: auto; } .ds-nav__logo { width: 2.45rem; height: 2.45rem; object-fit: contain; padding: 0.25rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 0.95rem; background: white; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav__wordmark { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.55rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; } .ds-nav__link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.55rem 0.95rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-hand); font-size: 1.02rem; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav__link:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: rgba(174, 228, 214, 0.45); } .ds-nav__toggle { display: inline-flex; min-width: 2.75rem; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--color-ink); cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav__toggle span { display: block; width: 1.1rem; height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-ink); margin: 2px 0; } .ds-nav__toggle:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: rgba(253, 233, 138, 0.3); } .ds-nav__toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(174, 228, 214, 0.45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Admin Input
components.description: Quiet utility field for the CMS, intentionally calmer than the public brand surfaces.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-field__label { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 3rem; border: 1px solid rgba(46, 61, 58, 0.15); border-radius: 0.95rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: rgba(244, 250, 249, 0.45); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(80, 107, 103, 0.7); } .ds-input:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: rgba(46, 61, 58, 0.35); background: white; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(174, 228, 214, 0.22); }

components.css: .ds-note { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; max-width: 12rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background: var(--color-yellow); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-hand); font-size: 0.95rem; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--color-ink); transform: rotate(-4deg); } .ds-note__dot { width: 0.9rem; height: 0.9rem; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-peach); box-shadow: inset -1px -2px 0 rgba(46, 61, 58, 0.18); } .ds-note__text { line-height: 1.1; }

narrative.overview: This design system makes the portfolio feel like evidence with personality. It leads with calm trust, then layers in hand-drawn expression through typography, scribbles, offset shadows, and paper-like surfaces. The public site is crafted and expressive, while the admin stays quieter and more utilitarian without abandoning the core brand DNA.
keyCharacteristics: Clear separation between brand expression and admin utility

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Never fall back to pure white or pure black. The paper and ink tones define the emotional trust baseline.

rules.name: The Signature-Then-Structure Rule
rules.body: Use Caveat and Patrick Hand to signal authorship and warmth, but let Nunito carry clarity and reading stability.

rules.name: The Shadow-Means-Object Rule
rules.body: Hard offset shadows are for tactile public surfaces. Softer elevation is reserved for the admin and support infrastructure.

dos: Do keep the paper base and ink structure intact before adding playful accents.
Do use accent colors with distinct jobs: yellow for action, mint for openness, peach for warmth.
Do preserve strong contrast, readable spacing, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't make the site feel template-like, too loud, or too generic.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism-by-default, side-stripe borders, or endless identical cards.
Don't let creativity overpower trust or comprehension.
